summary: Implemented and validated finite-shot Hubbard energy, double occupancy and kinetic energy with integer Born counts, marginal 95% Hoeffding intervals and exact prepared-state/ground-state references. Added actual independent-Pauli measurements at matched total preparations and exact sampling-variance diagnostics. The studio budget selector compares both strategies across three budgets and seven interactions. At U/t=8 and 20480 preparations, grouped energy sampling SD is 0.0312500 t versus 0.0947859 t for independent terms, but the grouped CI half-width remains 0.305179 t. All 21 tests, studio reproduction and the independent contract pass. Legacy APIs remain compatible; no hardware advantage or materials accuracy is claimed.
